plan.title: bug(design-critique): parent In plain English is an abbreviation, not the problem-and-solution reading

narratives.Description: Parent In plain English on the lean and the synthesis is too short when it only points at Bound-remedy ids. A later reader cannot tell what broke or how the bound map solves it. Both artifacts must state the problem and the accepted solution in ordinary language. The thin skill must point at the Plain-language summary section. Recut meaning is #4320, not this bind. Successor lean 5620856844.

narratives.UserStory: As a later reader of a bound arc, I want the lean and the synthesis to state the problem and the accepted solution in ordinary language, so that I do not have to ask in chat for a reading the abbreviated pointer did not carry.

items.title: Contract publishes that a summary which only points at Bound-remedy / comment ids is a miss, and that the problem and accepted solution must appear in ordinary language on both artifacts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given successor lean 5620856844, when this clause is implemented, then the observable behavior in this title holds and content-contract tests verify it.
